$comment: The program models this repository's program leg re-checks (Phase 2383): one release asset of https://github.com/Fuaran-Core/fuaran-program-dotnet, pinned by sha256. proofs/check.ps1 downloads it (or takes the local file -ProgramAsset / FUARAN_PROOFS_PROGRAM_ASSET names, for an offline run), refuses any other bytes, opens the models read-only from its models/ and holds the runtime floor and extractions committed under program/oracle/ to its oracle/. The asset is built reproducibly from that repository's proofs/asset.json, which commits this sha256, so a checkout of it builds exactly these bytes (pwsh proofs/check.ps1 -AssetOnly -AssetOutDir <dir>). Moving to a newer program release is changing these four values together, re-writing the committed oracle from the asset (check.ps1 -Leg program -Extract), then a cold run of the leg.
